body.message:
If this issue is not resolved immediately by either moving us to a clean and safe apartment or refunding the cost of one full day so I can move my children to another hotel, I will have no choice but to file an official complaint with Dubai Consumer Protection.

This is a serious health and safety issue involving my children, and I have photos and evidence of the bed bugs and the condition of the apartment.

I hope we can resolve this directly and immediately without having to escalate the matter.
